retrievalProfile.description: A 1960s-style album cover featuring a group beach picnic scene with high-contrast condensed display type and elegant script overlays.

recipe.visualDefinition: A sun-drenched beach scene featuring five young adults in 1960s attire sitting on a blanket among large rocks, topped with bold, orange-red condensed sans-serif and a flowing red script.
coreVisualRelationships: Bold block text anchored to the top edge
Script text layered over the horizon line
Subject group centered in the lower two-thirds
High-contrast lighting emphasizing textures of sand and rock
coreInvariants: Orange-red color for primary display typography
Presence of large, textured coastal rocks

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A group of five people occupies the central foreground and midground, scaled to fill the width between large flanking rocks.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bright orange-red block text at the top serves as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bold top text, move down through the elegant script, and settle on the smiling faces of the group.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space; the frame is densely packed with figures, rocks, and ocean waves.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Naturalistic beach tones (sandy beige, rocky grey, ocean blue)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant orange-red for typography and accents like the picnic bag
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Yellow and lime green in the clothing of the central figures
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the typography and clothing against a slightly desaturated, grainy photographic background.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain a warm, sun-bleached film quality

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Condensed grotesque and formal copperplate script
letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses extremely tight tracking and high vertical stretch
Secondary text uses long, sweeping swashes on the 'S' and 'L'
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' in the script has an elongated top curve that underlines the preceding word
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a rigid, industrial condensed sans-serif with a fluid, romantic script.
graphicDevices: Circular logo emblem in the top right corner

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, and tall proportions of the display text.
Captures the formal, elegant swashes of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 1960s-style photograph of a group of five young adults (three men, two women) having a picnic on a sandy beach. They are surrounded by large, dark, textured rocks. The ocean waves are visible in the background. The lighting should be bright and sunny with a vintage film grain. One woman is in a yellow swimsuit; the men wear colorful short-sleeve button-downs.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary display text in a bold, orange-red, extra-condensed sans-serif at the very top. Below it, add the subtitle in a dark red, elegant formal script with long swashes, centered over the horizon line.

verificationChecks: Is the top text extra-condensed and orange-red?
Does the script text have elegant swashes?
Is the photographic style consistent with 1960s film?
Are the subjects positioned between large rocks?

adjustableVariables: Number of people in the picnic group
postGenerationChecks: Check that the orange-red text is legible against the sky.
Ensure the script text does not obscure the faces of the subjects.
Confirm the presence of the large flanking rocks.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a sun-drenched 1960s lifestyle photo with a header of vertically-stretched condensed sans-serif and a sub-header of elegant copperplate script.
